blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Effective multi-domain adaptation of large language models requires prioritizing relevant domain knowledge while minimizing interference from irrelevant domains. Existing approaches commonly use Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to train a separate adapter for each domain and combine these adapters within one model. However, they either weight adapters equally regardless of the input domain or dynamically weight adapters while still activating all of them including irrelevant ones. Additionally, while efficient, their low-rank structure limits performance. In contrast, upcycling is a model expansion method that adds experts and a router to a dense Transformer layer offering larger capacity than LoRA approaches. In this paper, we propose Domain-Specialized Upcycling (DS-Upcycling) for multi-domain adaptation. We introduce a new domain-aware supervision that allows the router to effectively learn to distinguish domains by selecting the appropriate experts. During fine-tuning on each new domain, we update only the corresponding expert and router while freezing all other parameters. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest average performance across the adapted domains compared to baselines while retaining general performance. With just 256 examples per domain for router supervision, DS-Upcycling achieves 90-98% routing accuracy after adaptation compared with 43-70% for routers trained without our approach.
blocks.zh: 对大语言模型进行有效的多域调整,需要优先安排相关域名知识,同时尽量减少来自无关域的干扰. 现有方法通常使用Low-Rank适应(LORA)为每个域培训一个单独的适配器,并将这些适配器结合在一个模型中. 然而,无论输入领域如何,它们要么是加权适配器,要么是动态加权适配器,同时仍然激活所有适配器,包括不相关的适配器。 此外,虽然效率很高,但其低级结构限制了业绩。 相形之下,回升是一种模型扩展方法,它将专家和路由器添加到密集的变形器层上,提供比LORA方法更大的容量. 在本文中,我们提议进行多领域改造的域外特制循环(DS-Upcycling). 我们引入了一种新的域意识监督,使路由器能够通过选择合适的专家来有效学习区分域. 在对每一个新域进行微调时,我们只更新相应的专家和路由器,同时冻结所有其他参数. 实验显示,我们的方法在保持总体性能的同时,在经过调整的领域实现了与基线相比最高的平均性能. 由于每个域只有256个路由器监督的例子,DS-Upcycling在适应后实现了90-98%的路由精度,相比之下,43-70%的路由器在没有我们的方法下受训.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of general tasks ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) . However, domains involving consequential decisions such as biomedicine ( Luo et al., 2022 ; Singhal et al., 2023 ) and law ( Niklaus et al., 2024 ; Niklaus et al., 2025 ) require specialized knowledge beyond general capabilities that is induced via fine-tuning on domain specific data. Multi-domain adaptation extends this specialization to multiple domains, aiming to integrate their specialized knowledge within a single model ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Sukhbaatar et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在广泛的一般任务中表现出了强大的能力(Grattafiori等,2024;Yang等,2025a.). 然而,涉及生物医学(Luo等,2022年;Singhal等,2023年)和法律(Niklaus等,2024年;Niklaus等,2025年)等相应决定的领域需要超出一般能力的专门知识,而这种知识是通过对特定领域数据的微调诱导的。 多领域适应将这一专业化扩展到多个领域,目的是将其专业知识纳入单一模式(Chen等,2023;Sukhbaatar等,2024)。

blocks.en:
Multi-domain adaptation methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting of general-domain capabilities ( Li et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) and cross-domain interference ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Sukhbaatar et al., 2024 ) .
Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has been applied to address these challenges by freezing pre-trained weights and learning parameter updates through pairs of low-rank matrices ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . Additionally, separate adapters are trained for each domain and then combined within one model for adaptation.
However, these approaches either weight adapters equally regardless of the input domain ( Chitale et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Asadi et al., 2024 ) or dynamically weight adapters while still activating all of them including irrelevant ones ( Dou et al., 2024 ) . Beyond these limitations, LoRA’s adaptation performance is further constrained by its low-rank structure ( Biderman et al., 2024 ; Pletenev et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
多领域适应方法受到灾难性地忘记一般领域能力的影响(Li等,2024;Luo等,2025;Chen等,2023;Sukhbaatar等,2024)。
Low-Rank适应(LORA)已被应用来应对这些挑战,通过对低等矩阵冻结预先训练的重量和学习参数更新(Hu等,2022年). 此外,还为每个领域培训了单独的适应器,然后结合在一个适应模型中。
然而,无论输入域(Chitale等人,2023年;Wang等人,2023年;Asadi等人,2024年),这些加权适配器或动态加权适配器,或仍在激活所有适配器,包括不相关的适配器(Dou等人,2024年)。 除了这些限制之外,LORA的适应性能还受到其低级结构的进一步限制(Biderman等人,2024年;Pletenev等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Upcycling is a model expansion method that adds full multi-layer perceptron (MLP) experts and a router to a dense Transformer layer resulting in sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture (Figure 1 ). The new experts learn domain-specific knowledge without low-rank constraints. The router activates a subset of experts for each input and assigns weights to the selected experts. This offers a natural way to prioritize relevant domain knowledge and exclude irrelevant domain knowledge through selective expert activation ( Fedus et al., 2022 ; Komatsuzaki et al., 2023 ) . Despite these advantages, upcycling for multiple domain adaptation remains largely underexplored. A few recent studies have explored multilingual adaptation ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , but they rely on language-specific signals for router guidance that are not transferable to domains within a specific language (e.g., law or biomedical).
blocks.zh: 回旋是将全多层受体(MLP)专家与路由器添加到密集的变形器层上的一种模型扩展方法,导致稀疏的多层受体结构(图1). 新的专家在没有低级限制的情况下学习特定领域的知识。 路由器激活每个输入的子集专家,并给选定的专家分配权重. 这为通过选择性专家活化来优先考虑相关领域知识,排除无关领域知识提供了自然途径(Fedus等,2022;Komatsuzaki等,2023.). 尽管有这些优势,但多领域适应的回旋仍然在很大程度上没有得到充分利用。 最近的一些研究探索了多语种的适应性(周等,2025;张等,2025),但它们依靠语言特定信号进行路由器引导,这些信号不能被转移到特定语言(如法律或生物医学)内的域.

blocks.en: In this work, we propose Domain-Specialized Upcycling (DS-Upcycling) for multi-domain adaptation (Figure 2 ). We first train the router with a domain-aware objective using only a small number of examples from each domain. This encourages general inputs to use the original MLP and discourages specialized inputs from using irrelevant experts. During adaptation to each domain, we update only its corresponding expert and the router while freezing all other parameters. These domain-specific expert updates promote specialization by concentrating learning within the corresponding expert and limiting cross-domain interference. Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提议开展多领域改造(图2.)的域外专业循环。 我们首先对路由器进行有域-意识目的的训练,只使用从每个域中取出少量的例子. 这鼓励一般投入使用最初的MLP,并劝阻专门投入使用无关的专家. 在适应每个域时,我们只更新其相应的专家和路由器,同时冻结所有其他参数. 这些特定领域专家的更新通过将学习集中在相应的专家中,限制跨领域干扰,促进专业化。 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We propose DS-Upcycling for multi-domain adaptation. It outperforms existing baselines across specialized and general domains in two different model families. • Our domain-aware router supervision uses just 256 examples per domain, requiring to only instantiating the routers. • Our ablation study validates the contribution of each DS-Upcycling component. DS-Upcycling achieves 90–98% routing accuracy on specialized domains compared with 43–70% for routers trained without it.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multi-domain Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.1 多领域适应

blocks.en: LLM adaptation faces catastrophic forgetting of general-domain capabilities ( Li et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) and cross-domain interference ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Sukhbaatar et al., 2024 ) . To address these challenges, LoRA-based methods freeze pre-trained weights and learn updates through pairs of low-rank matrices ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . A common strategy trains one adapter per domain and combines their outputs with equal weights ( Chitale et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Asadi et al., 2024 ) . However, equal weighting prevents the model from prioritizing the adapter most relevant to the input domain. LoRAMoE addresses this limitation through a router that dynamically weights adapters ( Dou et al., 2024 ) . Yet it activates all adapters for every input and therefore cannot exclude irrelevant ones. Despite their efficiency, LoRA-based methods remain constrained by their low-rank architecture ( Biderman et al., 2024 ; Pletenev et al., 2025 ) . LLaMA-Pro instead inserts and trains additional transformer layers while freezing pre-trained parameters ( Wu et al., 2024 ) . Although it outperforms LoRA in specialized domains, its added layers are shared across domains and remain vulnerable to cross-domain interference. In contrast, our method trains full MLP experts for individual domains and selectively activates them.
blocks.zh: 适应LLM面临灾难性地忘记一般域能力(Li等,2024;Luo等,2025;和跨域干扰(Chen等,2023;Sukhbaatar等,2024;)). 为了应对这些挑战,基于LORA的方法冻结了预先训练的重量,并通过对低等矩阵学习更新(Hu等人,2022年)。 一个共同的战略是每个域训练一个适配器并将其输出与等重结合(Chitale等,2023;Wang等,2023;Asadi等,2024)。 然而,同等权重使得模型无法优先处理与输入域最相关的适配器. LORAMoE通过一个动态加权适配器的路由器来解决这一限制(Dou等,2024年). 然而它激活了每个输入的所有适配器,因此不能排除无关的适配器. LLaMA-Pro尽管效率高,但基于LORA的方法仍然受到其低等结构的限制(Biderman等,2024;Pletenev等,2025.). LLaMA-Pro转而在冻结预训练参数的同时插入并训练额外的变压层(Wu等,2024.). 虽然它在专门领域的业绩超过了LORA,但其所增加的分层是跨域共享的,仍然容易受到跨域干扰. 与此相反,我们的方法为单个领域培训完全的MLP专家,并有选择地激活他们.

blocks.en: Most upcycling work focuses on expert initialization for pre-training on large-scale general data. Komatsuzaki et al. (2023) find that duplicating the dense MLP performs best. However, identical initialization can hinder subsequent expert specialization ( Wei et al., 2024 ; Nakamura et al., 2025 ) . To address this issue, Muennighoff et al. (2025) randomly replace some weights in each copied expert. Nakamura et al. (2025) instead partially re-initialize experts using Gaussian distributions matched to pre-trained weight statistics. These methods use > > 200B tokens to train randomly initialized routers. However, they face two limitations in multi-domain adaptation. First, domain-specific datasets are much smaller than pre-training corpora and may be insufficient for randomly initialized routers to learn to distinguish domains from data alone. Second, making experts different at initialization does not ensure that they specialize in distinct domains unless subsequent training explicitly guides this specialization. Our method uses domain-aware router supervision to guide expert selection and domain-specific expert updates to promote specialization despite identical initialization.
blocks.zh: 大多数骑行工作侧重于专家初始化,以进行大规模一般数据的预训. Komatushaki等人(2023年)认为,复制密集的MLP效果最好。 然而,相同的初始化会阻碍随后的专家专业化(Wei等,2024;中村等,2025.). 为了解决这个问题,Muennighoff等人(2025年)随机更换了每位被复制专家中的一些权重. Nakamura等人(2025年)转而部分重新初始化专家,使用高斯分布与预训重量统计相匹配. 这些方法 > > 200B令牌来训练随机初始化路由器. 然而,它们在多领域适应方面面临两个限制. 首先,专有域的数据集远小于训练前的corpora,可能不足以使随机初始化的路由器学会单独区分域与数据. 第二,使专家在初始化时有所不同,不能确保专家在不同的领域具有专长,除非随后的培训明确指导这种专业化。 我们的方法使用域知路由器监督,指导专家选择和域特有专家更新,尽管初始化相同,但仍能促进专业化.

blocks.en: Upcycling methods outperform other methods on multilingual adaptation ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . Zhou et al. (2025) refine the router with language priors, and Zhang et al. (2025) add a language classifier to guide routing, with the latter requiring architectural changes beyond a standard MoE layer. Therefore, both methods are not transferable to domain adaptation within the same language. They depend on the language of an input being identifiable, so that routing can be tied to language identity. Specialized domains such as legal and biomedical in English, share the same script and much of the same vocabulary and offer no comparable surface-level signals. In contrast, our method requires neither domain-specific priors nor architectural changes beyond a standard MoE layer and applies to arbitrary domains.
blocks.zh: 循环方法比其他多语言适应方法要好(周等,2025.). Zhou等 (2025)用语言前传来精细路由器,而Zhang等 (2025)则会增加语言分级器来指导路由,而后者则需要超出标准MOE层的建筑改变. 因此,这两种方法都无法在同一种语言中用于域内适应。 它们取决于一个输入语言的可识别性,从而可以将路由与语言身份相挂钩. 英语中的法律和生物医学等专业领域,共用相同的脚本和许多相同的词汇,没有提供可比的地表水平信号. 相比之下,我们的方法既不需要特定域的前科,也不需要超出标准MOE层的建筑变化,并且适用于任意域.

blocks.en: All experts initially produce identical outputs and the selected experts’ routing weights sum to one. Their weighted output therefore matches the original MLP regardless of router selection.

blocks.en: 3.5 Domain-specific Expert Updates

blocks.en: DS-Upcycling has two training stages. First, each router is trained independently on the extracted hidden states using the domain-aware objective (§ 3.3 ). Second, the upcycled model is adapted to each target domain. Inspired by prior work ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , we update only the router and expert d d in each upcycled layer during adaptation to D d D_{d} while freezing all other parameters. Restricting each expert’s updates to its corresponding domain promotes expert specialization. This mitigates cross-domain interference while preserving the general expert’s pre-trained knowledge.

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
These methods retain the dense Transformer layer architecture.
(1) Simple FT updates all model parameters without architectural changes.
(2) LoRA trains a separate adapter for each domain and combines their outputs with equal weights ( Chitale et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Asadi et al., 2024 ) .
(3) LoRAMoE uses a router to dynamically weight all adapter outputs ( Dou et al., 2024 ) .
(4) LLaMA-Pro inserts new dense Transformer layers after each group of pre-trained layers and trains only the new layers ( Wu et al., 2024 ) .

(4)LLaMA-Pro在每组预训地层后再插入新的密集变压器地层,而列车仅使用新地层(Wu等,2024.).

blocks.en:

They randomly initialize routers and update all parameters during adaptation but differ in expert initialization.

(2) Duplication initializes each new expert by copying the dense MLP ( Komatsuzaki et al., 2023 ) .
(3) Random Perturb copies the dense MLP and randomly re-initializes a subset of its weights ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) .
(4) Partial Init copies the dense MLP and re-initializes a subset of its weights using Gaussians matched to their original distribution ( Nakamura et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: 5.1 Domain-specific Performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 特定领域 业绩

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the results in the biomedical and legal domains.
blocks.zh: 表1列出了生物医学和法律领域的结果。

blocks.en:
LoRAMoE performs best among these approaches and improves average performance in both domains.
However, these improvements are accompanied by declines on MedQA (Llama: 60.36 → 57.27 60.36\rightarrow 57.27 ; Qwen: 65.54 → 62.32 65.54\rightarrow 62.32 ) and Law-MMLU (Llama: 67.98 → 67.49 67.98\rightarrow 67.49 ; Qwen: 74.77 → 71.79 74.77\rightarrow 71.79 ).
Its domain-level gains do not consistently extend to individual tasks.
One possible explanation is interference among tasks within each domain.
Prior work has found that adapting low-rank adapters to multiple tasks can improve performance on some tasks while degrading others ( Yang et al., 2025b ) .
DS-Upcycling instead allows full MLP experts to learn domain-specific updates without low-rank constraints.
This greater capacity may help accommodate the different requirements of tasks within each domain.
Our method achieves the highest biomedical (Llama: 68.42; Qwen: 73.34) and legal (Llama: 68.96; Qwen: 72.15) averages across all methods, significantly outperforming the respective second-best baselines (paired t t -test, p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).
These domain-level gains are accompanied by improvements over the corresponding base model on every specialized-domain task.
blocks.zh:
LORAMoE在这些方法中表现最好,提高了两个领域的平均业绩。
然而,随着这些改善,MedQA(拉玛:60.36 → 57.27 60.36\ 右翼57.27;克文:65.54 → 62.32 65.54\ 右翼62.32)和Law-MMLU(拉玛:67.98 → 67.49 67.98\ 右翼67.49;克文:74.77 → 71.79 74.77\ 右翼71.79)也有所下降。
其域级收益并非一贯地延伸到单个任务.
一种可能的解释是,每个领域的任务相互干扰。
以前的工作发现,使低等适配器适应多种任务可以提高一些任务的性能,而降低其他任务的性能(Yang等,2025b.).
DS-Upcycling转而允许完整的MLP专家在没有低级限制的情况下学习特定域的更新.
这种更大的能力可能有助于满足每个领域任务的不同要求。
我们的方法实现了最高的生物医学标准(Llama:68.42;Quen:73.34)和法律标准(Llama:68.96;Quen:72.15),大大地超过了相应的第二好基线(paired t - t - test, p < 0.05 p < 0.05)。
在取得这些域级成果的同时,还改进了每个专门域任务的相应基准模型。

blocks.en:
Upcycling baselines fail to consistently improve performance across specialized domains.
For Llama-3.1-8B, even their highest biomedical (Duplication: 66.18 → 50.97 66.18\rightarrow 50.97 ) and legal (Random Init.: 60.30 → 56.62 60.30\rightarrow 56.62 ) averages fall below those of the base model.
For Qwen-3-8B, all upcycling baselines improve the legal average but reduce the biomedical average.
These results show that expert initialization alone may not ensure the reliable expert selection and specialization needed for multi-domain adaptation.
For expert selection, prior multilingual upcycling studies have found that explicit routing guidance improves adaptation performance ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
For expert specialization, prior MoE research has shown that concentrating task-specific updates within relevant experts supports effective adaptation ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
DS-Upcycling combines domain-aware router supervision to guide expert selection with domain-specific expert updates to concentrate each domain’s learning within its corresponding expert.
We further examine their contributions through routing analysis (§ 6.1 ), expert specialization analysis (§ 6.2 ), and ablations of both components (§ 6.3 ).
blocks.zh:
循环基线未能持续改善各专门领域的绩效。
对Llama-3.1-8B来说,即使是其最高的生物医学(乘数:66.18-50.97 66.18-正线50.97)和法律(Random Init.:60.30- 56.62 60.30-正线56.62)的平均值也低于基准模型。
对于Quen-3-8B,所有上行基准都改善了法律平均值,但降低了生物医学平均值.
这些结果表明,单靠专家初始化可能无法确保多领域适应所需的可靠的专家选择和专业化。
对于专家的选拔,之前的多语种循环研究发现,明确的路由指导可以提高适应性能(周等,2025;张等,2025.).
就专家专业化而言,教育部先前的研究表明,将具体任务更新集中在相关专家内部有助于有效适应(Wang等,2024;Li等,2025)。
DS-Upcycling将域-意识路由器监督结合起来,以指导专家选择与域特有专家更新,将每个域的学习集中在相应的专家内部.
我们通过路径分析(第6.1节)、专家专业分析(第6.2节)和两个组成部分的分解(第6.3节),进一步审查它们的贡献。

blocks.en: 5.2 General Performance
blocks.zh: 5.2 一般业绩

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the results on general-domain tasks. Overall, existing baselines struggle to consistently preserve general-domain capabilities.
blocks.zh: 表2列出一般领域任务的结果。 总体而言,现有基线难以始终如一地保持一般领域的能力。

blocks.en:
LoRAMoE is the only dense method that improves average performance in both model families (Llama: 67.92; Qwen: 69.30).
However, it still degrades five out of ten tasks on Llama-3.1-8B and three out of ten on Qwen-3-8B.
RTE performance declines substantially in both cases (Llama: 70.52 → 65.82 70.52\rightarrow 65.82 ; Qwen: 74.97 → 64.98 74.97\rightarrow 64.98 ).
One possible explanation is that freezing pre-trained parameters does not prevent domain-specific adapter updates from affecting general-domain performance.
Although LoRAMoE freezes pre-trained weights, it still combines all adapter outputs for general-domain inputs.
DS-Upcycling uses domain-aware router supervision to favor the general expert for these inputs, thereby reducing interference from specialized domains.
Our ablation study supports this interpretation, showing that removing domain-aware router supervision reduces general-domain performance on both model families (§ 6.3 ).
DS-Upcycling achieves the highest general-domain averages (Llama: 68.82; Qwen: 70.08) across all methods, significantly outperforming the respective second-best baselines (paired t t -test, p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).
Only two tasks decline slightly on Llama-3.1-8B (HellaSwag: 60.02 → 59.92 60.02\rightarrow 59.92 ; PIQA: 80.09 → 79.52 80.09\rightarrow 79.52 ).
For Qwen-3-8B, only RTE declines ( 74.97 → 72.80 74.97\rightarrow 72.80 ).
These results indicate that DS-Upcycling preserves general-domain capabilities more effectively.
blocks.zh:
LORAMOE是唯一一种能提高两个模范家庭平均性能的密集方法(Llama:67.92;Quen:69.30.
然而,它仍然在Llama-3.1-8B的10项任务中贬低了5项,在Quen-3-8B的10项任务中贬低了3项.
RTE在这两种情况下的性能都大幅度下降(Llama:70.52 – 65.82 70.52\右手65.82;Quen:74.97 – 64.98 74.97\右手64.98)。
一种可能的解释是,被冻结的预先训练的参数并不妨碍特定域的适配器更新影响一般域的性能.
尽管LORAMoE冻结了预先被训练的重量,但它仍然将所有适配器输出用于一般域输入.
DS-Upcycling使用有域意识的路由器监督,有利于这些输入的一般专家,从而减少来自专门领域的干扰.
我们的消化研究支持这种解释,表明去掉域-知路由器监督会降低两个模型家族的通域性能(第6.3节).
DS-Upcycling在所有方法中都实现了最高的通域平均值(Llama:68.82;Quen:70.08),显著地超过了相应的第二好基线(paired t-t-t-test, p < 0.05 p < 0.05).
在Llama-3.1-8B上只有两项任务略有下降(HellaSwag:60.02 ~ 59.92 60.02\右翼59.92;PIQA:80.09~ 79.52 80.09\右翼79.52)。
对Quen-3-8B来说,只有RTE下降(74.97 ~ 72.80 74.97\右翼 72.80.
这些结果显示,DS-Upcycling可以更有效地保持一般领域的能力.

blocks.en:
All upcycling baselines reduce average general-domain performance on both model families.
Even their highest averages fall below those of the base models (Llama-3.1-8B, Duplication: 67.79 → 52.77 67.79\rightarrow 52.77 ; Qwen-3-8B, Random Init.: 67.99 → 66.22 67.99\rightarrow 66.22 ).
Updating all parameters during specialized-domain adaptation may alter pre-trained knowledge.
Duplication falls to 52.77 for Llama and 65.89 for Qwen despite initially matching the dense model’s outputs.
Preserving initial outputs alone might be insufficient to retain general-domain capabilities after adaptation.
DS-Upcycling instead freezes pre-trained parameters and updates only the corresponding expert and router during adaptation to each domain.
Our ablation further supports the contribution of domain-specific expert updates to retaining general-domain performance (§ 6.3 ).
Even with the general expert frozen, updating all specialized experts lowers general-domain averages on both model families.
In general, we observe that freezing pre-trained parameters and restricting expert updates to their corresponding domains help mitigate general-domain catastrophic forgetting.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 6 Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 分析

blocks.en: 6.1 Routing Quality
blocks.zh: 6.1 运行质量

blocks.en: To evaluate whether domain-aware router supervision (§ 3.3 ) helps routers distinguish input domains, we compare DS-Upcycling with upcycling baselines that randomly initialize their routers. We sample 128 additional examples per domain (general, legal and biomedical) with no overlap with those used for router supervision. We measure routing accuracy in the upcycled models before and after adaptation by checking if the expert corresponding to the input domain is among the selected experts.
blocks.zh: 为了评价有域-意识的路由器监理(§3.3)是否帮助路由器区分出输入域,我们比较DS-Upcycling与可随机初始化其路由器的上回循环基线. 我们对每个域(一般、法律和生物医学)增加的128个例子进行了抽样,与用于路由器监督的例子没有重叠。 我们通过检查与输入域相对应的专家是否在选定的专家之列,衡量适应前后上下循环模型的路径精度.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports routing accuracy across domains. For Duplication, routing accuracy remains largely unchanged across all three domains after adaptation (Llama general: 63.75 → 62.62 63.75\rightarrow 62.62 , legal: 69.31 → 69.56 69.31\rightarrow 69.56 , and biomedical: 63.00 → 63.56 63.00\rightarrow 63.56 ). The other upcycling baselines become strongly biased toward the general domain while routing accuracy on legal and biomedical inputs declines substantially (Random Init. on Llama general: 68.31 → 99.62 68.31\rightarrow 99.62 , legal: 62.94 → 51.00 62.94\rightarrow 51.00 , and biomedical: 61.06 → 42.69 61.06\rightarrow 42.69 ). This pattern shows that training on domain-specific data alone does not enable randomly initialized routers to reliably select the corresponding specialized experts. This routing failure contributes to the specialized-domain performance degradation observed in § 5.1 .

This routing stability indicates that domain-aware router supervision enables consistent selection of appropriate experts across domains. This explains the consistent specialized-domain performance gains achieved by our method.

blocks.en: 6.2 Expert Specialization
blocks.zh: 6.2 专家

blocks.en: We next evaluate whether restricting each expert’s updates to its corresponding domain (§ 3.5 ) promotes specialization despite identical initialization. Following prior work ( Li et al., 2017 ) , we compute the cosine similarity between the biomedical and legal experts’ parameter updates as: Cos ⁡ ( W Bio trained − W Bio init , W Legal trained − W Legal init ) \mathrm{Cos}\left(W_{\mathrm{Bio}}^{\mathrm{trained}}-W_{\mathrm{Bio}}^{\mathrm{init}},W_{\mathrm{Legal}}^{\mathrm{trained}}-W_{\mathrm{Legal}}^{\mathrm{init}}\right) .

blocks.en: Table 4 shows the results. Lower similarity indicates less aligned update directions and serves as an indicator of expert specialization. Duplication yields high update similarity across both model families. This suggests that its experts have similar parameter updates despite being intended for different domains. Other upcycling baselines achieve lower similarity but alter the pre-trained model’s outputs at initialization. This can hinder subsequent adaptation ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2026b ) and contribute to the general-domain degradation observed in § 5.2 . In contrast, DS-Upcycling starts from the same copied weights as Duplication yet achieves low update similarity comparable to the other upcycling baselines. Restricting each expert’s updates to its corresponding domain therefore enables identically initialized experts to specialize in distinct domains.
blocks.zh: 表4显示了结果。 相似性较低表明更新方向不太一致,是专家专业化的指标。 重复使两个模范家庭都具有高度的更新相似性。 这表明,尽管打算针对不同领域,但其专家也有类似的参数更新。 其他回旋基线的相似性较低,但在初始化时会改变预先训练过的模型的输出。 这可能会妨碍随后的适应(Wu等,2024;Cao等,2026b),并导致第5.2节所观察到的一般领域退化。 相形之下,DS-Upcycling从复制的重量开始,与重复性相同,然而却实现了与其他回升基线相似的低更新. 因此,将每位专家的更新限制在相应的领域,使同样初始化的专家能够专门从事不同的领域。

blocks.en: 6.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 6.3 读取研究

blocks.en: We compare DS-Upcycling with a variant that randomly initializes routers without domain-aware supervision while keeping all other components unchanged. Table 5 shows that domain-aware router supervision improves average performance in five of the six settings spanning two model families and three domains. The only exception is the biomedical domain on Qwen-3-8B where the average decreases slightly from 73.46 to 73.34. These results validate the contribution of domain-aware router supervision to effective multi-domain adaptation.

Table 5 shows that restricting updates to the corresponding expert improves average performance across all six settings. These results validate the effectiveness of promoting expert specialization through domain-specific expert updates.
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们的策略是,通过将DS-Upcycling与一个在适应每个领域的过程中更新所有专业专家的变体相提并论,将每个专家的更新限制在相应的领域。 表5显示,将更新限制在相应的专家之内,可以提高所有六个环境的平均业绩。 这些结果证实了通过特定领域的专家更新促进专家专业化的有效性。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we proposed DS-Upcycling for adapting pre-trained language models to multiple specialized domains. It adds full MLP experts to learn domain-specific knowledge without low-rank constraints and a router to selectively activate relevant experts. Domain-aware router supervision encourages the selection of the general expert for general-domain inputs and suppresses irrelevant experts for specialized-domain inputs. Domain-specific expert updates promote specialization by updating only the corresponding expert and router during adaptation to each domain while freezing all other parameters. Our experiments show that DS-Upcycling offers the highest average performance across specialized and general domains. After adaptation, it achieves 90–98% routing accuracy on specialized domains compared with 43–70% for existing upcycling baselines. Our analysis suggest that domain-aware router supervision and domain-specific expert updates help prioritize relevant domain knowledge while minimizing interference from irrelevant domains. These findings highlight the potential of upcycling for effective multi-domain adaptation.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了DS-Upcycleming,用于将预训语言模型适应多个专业领域. 它添加了完整的MLP专家来学习没有低等限制的域特有知识,并添加了路由器来有选择地激活相关的专家. 域知路由器监督鼓励选择一般域输入的普通专家,并压制无关的专家进行专门域输入. 域特有专家更新可促进专业化,只在适应每个域时更新相应的专家和路由器,同时冻结所有其他参数. 我们的实验表明,DS-Upcycling在专业领域和一般领域的平均性能最高。 改造后,它在专业领域实现了90-98%的路线精确度,而现有的上行基准为43-70%。 我们的分析表明,域认识路由器监管和域特定专家更新有助于确定相关域知识的优先次序,同时将无关域的干扰降至最低。 这些调查结果突出表明了骑自行车有效多领域适应的潜力。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: DS-Upcycling demonstrates strong multi-domain adaptation performance and mitigates forgetting. Unlike low-rank adaptation methods, DS-Upcycling allocates full MLP experts to prevent the expressivity bottlenecks common in multi-task LoRA. Consequently, while inference computation and latency remain bounded by sparse Top-2 activation, the total static parameter footprint stored in GPU memory scales linearly with the number of instantiated domains. An intersting avenue for future work is to integrate our approach with post-adaptation expert quantization or pruning. This would optimize the storage footprint in memory-constrained serving environments supporting multiple domains.
blocks.zh: DS-回升显示强多领域适应性能并缓解遗忘. 与低等级的适应方法不同,DS-Upcycling分配了完整的MLP专家来防止多任务LORA常见的表达性瓶颈. 因此,虽然推论计算和耐受性仍然以稀疏的Top-2活化为界限,但GPU内存尺度中储存的总静态参数足迹与即时域数呈线性. 今后工作的一个相互交织的途径是,将我们的方法与适应后专家量化或挤压相结合。 这将优化支持多个域的内存受限服务环境的存储足迹。

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation details
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: Following Fedus et al. (2022) and Cao et al. (2026a) , we upcycle the base model’s odd-numbered layers so that half become sparse MoE layers. Each upcycled layer retains the original MLP as the general expert and adds two specialized experts for the legal and biomedical domains. We use Top-2 routing to activate the two experts with the highest routing probabilities ( Fedus et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: Fedus等人(2022年)和Cao等人(2026年a年)之后,我们循环了基数模型的奇数分层,使一半成为稀疏的MOE分层. 每个上循环层保留原有的MLP作为一般专家,并增加两名法律和生物医学领域的专门专家。 我们使用Top-2的路由,激活了路线概率最高的两位专家(Fedus等人,2022年).

blocks.en: For Random Initialization , we initialize new expert weights from 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.02 2 ) \mathcal{N}(0,0.02^{2}) following Yang et al. (2025a) . For Random Perturbation , we replace 50% of each new expert’s weights with values sampled from 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.02 2 ) \mathcal{N}(0,0.02^{2}) following Muennighoff et al. (2025) . For Partial Initialization , we re-initialize 50% of each new expert’s weights using Gaussian distributions matched to their original mean and variance following Nakamura et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 对于随机初始化,我们初始化了NQ(0, 0.02, )\ mathcal{N}(0, 0.02, ^{2})继杨等(2025a)之后的新的专家权重. 在随机扰动中,我们用从Muennighoff等人(2025年)之后的N-Q(0,0.02,0.02,0. 在部分初始化方面,我们重新启动每名新专家50%的权重,使用与中村等人(2025年)之后的原始平均值和差异相匹配的高斯分布。

blocks.en: We use similar parameter counts across the multi-domain adaptation baselines for a fair comparison. All these baselines update only newly added parameters except Simple FT. Each LoRA adapter has rank 1024 for LoRA and 1536 for LoRAMoE. For LLaMA-Pro, we divide the base model into four layer groups and insert seven new transformer layers per group.
blocks.zh: 我们使用跨多领域适应基线的类似参数进行公平比较。 所有这些基线都只更新了新添加的参数,但简单FT除外. 每一个LORA适配器对LORA有1024级,对LORAMOE有1536级. 对于LLaMA-Pro,我们把基型分为四层并每组插入七个新的变压器层.

blocks.en: Appendix B Hyper-parameter Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 超参数 细节

blocks.en: We use a global batch size of 64 and a sequence length of 4096. For both domains, we use a cosine learning rate schedule with warm-up and decay from 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} to 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} . During biomedical adaptation, we lower this range to 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} – 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} for the upcycling baselines and Simple FT because the original range yielded poor performance in our preliminary experiments. We fine-tune all models on a single NVIDIA GH200 (96GB) using Flash-Attention 2 ( Dao, 2024 ) and bf16 mixed precision. We evaluate all models zero-shot using the Language Model Evaluation Harness ( Gao et al., 2024 ) .
